story.title: Climate Action or Economic Suicide? Biden's New Power Plant Emissions Standards Spark Firestorm
story.conservative_headline: Biden's EPA Mandates Threaten Grid Reliability and Jobs, Force Costly Green Tech on Coal Plants
story.liberal_headline: EPA Finalizes Historic Climate Rules to Cut Power Plant Pollution, Protect Public Health
story.poll_question: Should the EPA enforce strict emissions limits on existing power plants?
story.poll_option1_desc: Regulations threaten grid stability, jobs, and affordable electricity for American families.
story.poll_option2_desc: Standards are essential to combat climate change and reduce deadly air pollution.
